_doc: Thresholds of scripts/compare/gate.py. audio.p99_margin_ms: how far a pass's median-client p99 may sit above this host's recorded baseline (gate-baseline.json) for that pass; the local lab's p99 moves by about 1 ms with host load (handover 24 Nov), so the margins are the noise of repeated passes, not targets. beside_4k_*: audio on an edge that carries no 4K, with the 4K rung running, minus the same run's audio alone (opus1-clean). video.must_carry: the rungs every 4K viewer must carry by the referee's rule (on_time_min of frames on time, no stall over stall_ms); other rungs are reported. cpu_share_max: a node's mean CPU over the window as a share of its own CPUs (2 for a forwarder or edge, 4 for the contributor) at a must-carry rung.
